name: Mahou Shoujo Hanasaki Hotaru
original_name: 魔法少女 花咲ほたる
source:
A new magical girl has awoken! Hanasaki Hotaru fights to protect the peace of the city. But she is captured by the enemies who are anxious to play with her young body.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-october-2000-baldr-bullet.html]vndbreview[/url]]
